activity.notes: Sundblom was a leading figure of the Åland movement and became the first Speaker of the autonomous Åland Landsting on 9 June 1922, remaining Speaker until his death on 23 August 1945. Åland is retained as the represented autonomous political community rather than flattening him into Finland, consistent with ATLAS's minority/small-polity representation rule.

sources.title: Julius Sundblom — Ålands lagting
sources.citation_text: The official Åland parliament records Sundblom as Speaker from the first Landsting term beginning 9 June 1922 through 1945.

sources.title: Tidigare talmän och vice talmän i Ålands lagting
sources.citation_text: Ålands lagting lists Julius Sundblom as Speaker from 1922 to 1945.
